name: crab-ledger
description: Side pane: daily tokens, minutes, git lines, cost estimate, efficiency trend, most re-read files and what to optimize, subagents included. Animated pixel crab.

showSubagents.title: Show live subagents
showSubagents.description: Cards for the subagents of the session (progress, time left, efficiency, final grade) in the ledger pane.

showOperators.title: Show operators
showOperators.description: Operators sections: read sync/operators.toml, sync/<ID>.md and SYNC.md of the repo from its remote branch (git fetch every 5 minutes). Only appear when the repo has them.

syncBranch.title: Sync branch
syncBranch.description: Branch that holds SYNC.md and sync/ (for example sync/my-project). "auto" picks the most recently updated origin/sync/* branch that has a sync/operators.toml, and falls back to the default branch.

statusFile.title: Sync status page (status.md)
statusFile.description: A second tab "Sync status" drawn from this markdown page (operators, queues, reviews, requests for you, Beta progress). ~ is your home folder. The tab only appears when the file exists; empty turns it off.

autoCloseSeconds.title: Close finished subagent cards after (seconds)
autoCloseSeconds.description: A subagent card that is done or failed closes by itself this many seconds after it ended. 0 keeps cards until you press close.
